issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This indicates a scroll-related container (likely a scroll spy, parallax, or sticky element) is missing a non-static CSS position property.
issues.element: Unknown scroll container component — likely a parallax wrapper, sticky nav, or scroll-tracking div
issues.root_cause: A component using a scroll offset calculation library (e.g., react-scrollspy, framer-motion scroll, or a custom useScroll hook) is attached to a container that has default static positioning. The container needs position: relative (or fixed/absolute) set explicitly.

issues.element: Hero section background / page background color
issues.root_cause: The global background or hero wrapper likely has a CSS background-color that differs from #091829, or an overlay div with opacity/color is too dark, overriding the intended navy hue.
